Aworg.name: Aworg: Hero in the Sky
Aworg.summary: Aworg: Hero in the Sky is an action game for the Sega Mega Drive, released exclusively in Japan via the Sega Game Toshokan service. Find keys to escape increasingly complex mazes.

Dragon Slayer - Eiyuu Densetsu.name: Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes
Dragon Slayer - Eiyuu Densetsu.summary: In this epic role-playing game, you must guide Prince Logan all accross the beautiful and dngerious world of Isrenasa in the quest to regain his throne. This game features a huge world to explore and many companions to join you on your journey. This game features one of the largest quests and most advanced interface of any role-playing game for the TurboDuo system.

Generals of the Yang Family - Clan of He.name: Clan of Heroes: Generals of the Yang Family
Generals of the Yang Family - Clan of He.summary:
Clan of Warriors - Generals of the Yang Family is a beat'em up that is based off the story several old Chinese stories and Folklore Songs.

Choose between 4 playable warriors to defend your country from foreign military invaders.

This title was originally released exclusively in China. Piko Interactive acquired the full rights of the game to localize it to English speaking players. The game has been completely re-hauled fixing many of the original bugs and play ability problems. There is a lot of polishing done to the fighting and collision engine. Over all the game was worked up to be finally enjoyable from beginning to end.
